profile.headline: Software Engineer at Cambia Health Solutions
profile.summary: Back-end Typescript / Clojure developer working on mobile and web apps for Regence insurance network.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed Backend for frontend (BFF) services for the Regence health insurance portal, writing HIPAA compliant code and adding new features to enroll for health insurance, search for doctors, research medications, view personal healthcare data, and chat with healthcare professionals.

• Implemented various microservices and serverless solutions in Clojure and Typescript for an application with over 1 million active users.

• Used Lacinia and Apollo libraries to write various GraphQL services behind a federated Apollo gateway

• Worked cross functionally with infosec, analytics, product, and front-end teams to develop audit trails, generate events, and develop new features.

• Implemented BDD and integration testing with Cucumber to ensure HIPAA compliance and app functionality with stakeholders.

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed, tested, and optimized high-volume data pipelines with Clojure, Java, and Python.

• Modeled data for use in Cassandra and Elasticsearch databases to ensure optimal querying and exporting of geo-temporal data.

• Leveraged spatial data structures like R-Trees and geohashes for efficient retrieval and aggregation of billions of records.

• Worked on transition from VM to Kubernetes & container infrastructure, reducing costs and allowing us to scale services more easily.

• Implemented Prometheus, Grafana, and AlertManager cluster resource monitoring for a bare-metal Kubernetes cluster.

• Organized monthly lunch & learn events for the office, encouraging knowledge sharing across teams.

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
• As part of the Data Quality & Analytics team, designed scalable, distributed datasets (10 million+ data points) using Apache Spark and Python to build bookings and operational metrics reports.

• Automated recurrent ad-hoc report and analysis requests through development of high-volume ETL data pipelines and comprehensive data visualizations.

• Produced and optimized performance tracking business intelligence reports built upon relational (Teradata, Hadoop, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, RESTful API) data stores.

• Delivered timely quantitative analyses for identifying and improving low performance partners.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Created surveys for use in epidemiological studies related to HIV and intravenous drug use.

• Translated doctors notes from Spanish to English and inputted results in a database.

company.name: University of California, San Diego - School of Medicine
